ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a second-generation Show 5 and just got its stand; an older model adds little.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to control a lamp through the Alexa devices I already use.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with clock and Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The clock is useful, but I recently got a fourth-generation Dot and would pass this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a newer Dot, so I have no immediate reason to add this older version.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger display interests me, but my recently purchased Show 5 meets my current needs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing 4K Max makes another HD streaming stick unnecessary right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Removable storage fits my interests, but I already have a multiport card reader and no immediate need for this bundle.
ItemID: NA; Title: Seagate Expansion 16TB External Hard Drive HDD - USB 3.0, with Rescue Data Recovery Services (STKP16000402); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would consider this for more backup space alongside my older 4TB external drive; I would expect useful capacity but would need to assess reliability.
ItemID: NA; Title: Samsung 970 EVO Plus SSD 2TB NVMe M.2 Internal Solid State Hard Drive, V-NAND Technology, Storage and Memory Expansion for Gaming, Graphics w/ Heat Control, Max Speed, MZ-V7S2T0B/AM; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current internal-drive upgrade planned and would need to confirm that my computer supports this SSD.
